categories.main_business_segments: Ilsung Construction Co Ltd operates primarily in civil engineering and construction, including public infrastructure projects such as highways, railroads, and subways, as well as residential and commercial building construction like apartments, officetels, and office buildings. The company also engages in landscaping, apartment sales, overseas public ODA projects in Southeast Asia, and B2B business facilities construction, including US military facility projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes construction and civil engineering technologies with licenses in civil engineering, architectural construction, industrial/environmental facilities, and landscaping. It applies project-based construction contracts with revenue recognized based on construction progress. Ilsung has developed patented excavation guide casing technology to improve efficiency and reduce costs in foundation piling work.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies such as LH (Korea Land & Housing Corporation), Korea Expressway Corporation, Korea Railroad Corporation, and public institutions like the Ministry of Public Works in Cambodia and other Southeast Asian countries. Major private clients include Samsung Electronics and Samsung Display for corporate office facilities. The company serves both domestic public and private sectors and overseas public ODA markets in Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ilsung operates mainly in South Korea with significant domestic projects and has established a Southeast Asia regional headquarters focusing on Cambodia, Vietnam, and Laos for overseas public infrastructure projects. It also undertakes projects in the Philippines, Paraguay, and Mongolia, reflecting a growing international presence in ODA-funded construction.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ilsung functions primarily as a midstream construction contractor, engaging in project bidding, construction execution, and delivery of infrastructure and building projects. It operates downstream in the supply chain by providing construction services directly to public and private clients, including project management and sales of developed residential properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes ESG management and carbon neutrality initiatives, integrating safety and health management systems including appointing a Chief Safety Officer and establishing a Safety and Health Management Committee. R&D efforts focus on construction technology innovation, such as patented excavation methods to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Ilsung invests in research and development with dedicated teams and allocates approximately 0.58% of sales to R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Ilsung generates revenue primarily through construction contract work, recognizing income based on the percentage of project completion. Revenue streams include domestic and overseas civil and architectural construction projects, apartment sales, and B2B facility construction contracts. The company also earns from landscaping and real estate development activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ilsung ranks 69th nationally in construction capability evaluation among over 3,000 companies, indicating a mid-tier position in the Korean construction industry. It competes with other general construction firms in public infrastructure and residential development sectors, leveraging its expertise in B2B corporate facilities and overseas ODA projects to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 607.7 billion KRW in 2023, a 31.37% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising 166.89% to 7.3 billion KRW. Total assets stood at about 409.3 billion KRW with a debt ratio of 227.32%. Ilsung has shown a growth trajectory supported by expanding B2B business and overseas projects, maintaining stable capital and managing debt prudently.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ilsung emphasizes high-quality, reliable construction with a focus on customer satisfaction, safety, and ESG compliance. Its competitive edge lies in diversified capabilities across civil, architectural, and landscaping construction, strong public and private sector relationships, and expertise in overseas ODA projects. The company also differentiates through innovative construction technologies and a strategic focus on B2B corporate facility projects.
